rows.en: ...You idiot! Like hell I am! Shut your mouth!
Whatever. I'll tag along with you a little longer.
Welcome, Kamen Rider 1! And the real Rider 2!
Whew, you really saved our lives.
...I never knew a place like this existed.
I'm Seravee Gundam. I handle the strategy side of things.
I'm Methuss. I'm in charge of running the Item Lab.
I'm Hikari. I handle technical support.
The heroes discussed a plan for their next objective: rescuing the Ultra Warriors.
...So the path to the place with the cross is blocked by boulders?
A small but powerful bomb would do the trick... Unfortunately, we have nothing suitable here.
A small bomb, huh...
Then let's just swipe one from the enemy!?
I doubt the enemy would be so convenient as to have one, though.
No, the enemy researches weapons and ammo too. They must be storing them somewhere.
My suspicion is the area even further in from where we were being held.
Ikadevil was coming and going from there a lot, too.
See!? You hear that, you lot!? If Rider 1 says so, it's gotta be true!
Understood. Then investigate that area.
Right, I'll go with you!
{8074} and the others returned to base and handed the bomb-like objects to Hikari.
So these are the bombs you brought back...
...I see.
...Well done! This is "Spiner."
Spiner?
It's what you'd call a high-yield explosive. The enemy must've been trying to improve it.
With this, we should be able to destroy the rocks blocking the path.
Understood! We'll give it a try!
Kyaaaaaaah!!
What's going on!!
A kaiju...!!
What!? A kaiju in our base!?
Leave it to me!! What kind of kaiju is it!?
I-Its mouth is bigger than its face... It has tiny eyeballs on the tips of its antennae...
A big, pudgy belly... And there was some kind of counter on its chest.
...? Could that be...
Wait for meee~~~!!
Here it comes...!! It followed me here!!
I'm not anybody suspicious~
Kanegon!!
...Y-You know who I am!?
Of course! You're Kanegon, the Coin Monster, right?
Phew, what a relieeef~
Kanegon, how did you get here?
I dunnooo~ When I came to, I was just here.
Just like us, then.
Hey, is it okay if I stay here?
Of course it is! That's all right, isn't it?
Sure. If you're one of us, you're welcome here.
I don't see a problem.
Thaaank youuu~ Then I'll help out with something.
Let's see... In that case, there's an untouched storeroom next door. Could you clean it up for us?
Easy peasy~
Kanegon happily left the Briefing Room.
And then...
Hey! Something crazy's happened to the storeroom next door!
Huh? But Kanegon was supposed to be cleaning it up for us.
This is way past "cleaning." The whole inside's been completely changed.
Wait, what do you mean?
Ehehehehe...!
Did you build that? What the hell is that place even for?
You don't know? It's a casino. The "Kanegon Casino"!
A casino...!?
I wanted to be useful to everyone, so I thought really hard about it, y'know?
Fighting all the time wears you out, right? When it does, you unwind at the casino!
Anyway, come check it out!
...We've confirmed the Ultra Sign here as well.
There are Ultra Warriors in the fourth Cube too?
Yes... It's the "Ultra Cube." Our homeland, the Land of Light, was absorbed into it.
However, the shapes and layout of its facilities differ from the real Land of Light.
It doesn't seem to have been faithfully reconstructed.
...You seem to know a lot about it.
The truth is, the "Ultra Cube" is where I awoke.
What? Then how did you end up...
Having lost my power, I was defeated by the enemy and taken to the "Hideout Cube"...
So that's how it was. Then if there are other Ultra Warriors there too, that's...
Yes... not surprising at all.
We've gotta go help them!
But wait. Unless we can break through that wall...
